evidence.quote: Required application documents: officially translated certificates copy of passport/ID card with recognisable photo current CV (with complete details up to the date of application) proof of your German language skills at the required level proof of your English language skills at the required level (see current study and examination regulations on the relevant programme pages)

notes: Tuition: the programme states there are no tuition fees; the 376.80 EUR semester contribution is a general institution-wide fee, not tuition for this programme. Intake: the pages give the uni-assist deadline range 1 May–15 June; no day-month-year deadline for a specific year is quoted on the programme's own pages, so the year in the deadlines comes from the page's stated application period for winter semester 2026/2027 (deadline table). Application channel: pages say foreign-diploma applicants apply via uni-assist e.V., not via a VPD route and not directly in the TH portal.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate

note.fr: Un niveau d'anglais B2.2 (CECRL) est exigé pour l'admission ; des justificatifs précis sont acceptés (voir la liste officielle TH Wildau). Vérifiez la validité de votre certificat.
note.en: English at B2.2 (CEFR) is required for admission; specific accepted certificates are listed by TH Wildau. Check your certificate's validity.

evidence.quote: which corresponds to at least B2.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)
